dnssec_enabled.description: Enable DNSSEC validation to verify authenticity of DNS responses.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads. Use 0 for automatic detection based on CPU cores.

listen_addrs.description: List of IP addresses and ports to listen on for DNS queries.

address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to bind to.

upstream_servers.description: Upstream DNS resolvers (e.g., Quad9, Cloudflare, or your ISP’s DNS).

items.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of an upstream resolver.

cache_size_mb.description: Maximum DNS cache size in megabytes.

cache_ttl_min.description: Minimum TTL (seconds) for cached entries. Prevents overly aggressive caching of short-lived records.

cache_ttl_max.description: Maximum TTL (seconds) for cached entries. Caps caching duration to avoid stale data.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs. 'notice' is recommended for production.

root_hints_path.description: Optional custom path to root hints file (e.g., /etc/knot-resolver/root.hints). Leave empty to use default IANA root zone.

stub_zones.description: Stub zones for conditional forwarding to specific upstreams for certain domains.

domain.description: Domain name to configure conditional forwarding for.

policy_zones.description: Policy zones for domain-level behavior (e.g., block or restrict specific domains).

items.description: Domain pattern (exact or wildcard) to apply policy to.

bind_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (e.g., 'eth0', 'lan') to bind to instead of IP addresses.

ecs_enabled.description: Enable EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) to pass client network info to upstream resolvers for geo-aware responses.

rate_limit_qps.description: Rate limit: max queries per second per client IP. Set to null or omit to disable rate limiting.

rate_limit_window.description: Time window (seconds) for rate limiting calculation. Used only if rate_limit_qps is set.
